mapper.select: select email, role, to_char(last_login at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') last_login from users where tenant_id = #{tid} order by case role when 'owner' then 0 when 'sub' then 1 else 2 end, email

select actor, detail->>'note' note, to_char(at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') at, at > now() - interval '92 days' fresh from audit_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and action = 'access.review' order by id desc limit 1
select doc->'org'->'sec'->>'krOnly' from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
mapper.update: update tenant_state set doc = jsonb_set(jsonb_set(doc, '{org,sec}', coalesce(doc->'org'->'sec', '{}'::jsonb)), '{org,sec,krOnly}', to_jsonb(#{on}::boolean)) where tenant_id = #{tid}
